planets.name: TOI-4641 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4641 with a 22.1-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-4641 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-4641. Its orbit and size follow Bieryla et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
